statement: The full comparative-efficiency planning candidate uses one L0 scale prerequisite link, seals C0 as the prerequisite for calculator and semantic-parity work, preserves every previously verified outcome-neutral evidence contract, and passes independent exact-diff verification.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The landing candidate must contain the entire attempt-1 planning union, its rejection provenance, and the verifier-requested corrections; it may not commit a partial fix over uncommitted predecessor bytes.
This Quest authors planning contracts and draft successor Quests only; it must not claim that comparative performance, cost, or scale has been measured.
The same independent verifier must approve the SHA-256-bound full replacement diff before handoff.
